def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    can_fit = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    # Compute utilization ratio after adding item, avoiding log(0)
    utilization_ratio = np.where(can_fit, (bins - remaining) / bins, 0)
    # Use log of utilization ratio to favor higher utilization, but avoid log(0)
    valid_utilization = np.where(utilization_ratio > 1e-10, utilization_ratio, 1e-10)
    priorities[can_fit] = np.log(valid_utilization[can_fit])
    return priorities
